note: Small wooded RV park beside I-35 on the edge of Moose Lake, next to Moose Lake State Park, with a wildlife pond, game room and playground. It markets direct access to the Soo Line ATV trail and has ATV trails on the property. Its website was last updated for the 2022 season and posts no rates; call ahead. --Claude
